title: Automatic D1 migrations in production deploys
summary: GitHub production deployments now apply pending D1 migrations before deploying the Worker, with Wrangler pinned in the repository. Existing migration tracking skips files already applied.
details: The deployment workflow runs wrangler d1 migrations apply SAVES --remote before the Worker deploy inside the existing guarded, serialized shell. The focused test_release_workflow suite passed 10 tests, including a stubbed execution proving migrations precede deployment and migration failure stops the deploy. Remote replay verification and public deployment remain pending.
limitation: Live production behavior has not yet been verified; remote migration replay and the GitHub Actions deployment are still pending.
